issues.explanation: Chapter 32 already narrates Cao Pi entering Yuan Shao’s residence, seeing the two women, and attempting to kill them; Chapter 33 then replays that same arrival and discovery as its opening scene. This creates a backward/repeated handoff.
issues.suggested_fix: End Chapter 32 with Cao Pi entering the residence or seeing the two women, then let Chapter 33 carry the full identification and encounter; alternatively remove the repeated opening from Chapter 33.
